Fever, Cough, Sore throat, Runny nose, Nasal congestion, Headache, Fatigue, Diarrhea, Nausea, and Vomiting.

text_blocks.snippet: In some cases, children may develop more severe symptoms, such as:
Difficulty breathing, Chest pain, Confusion, Seizures, and Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C).
It's important to note that these symptoms can also be caused by other illnesses, so it's essential to consult a healthcare professional for an accurate diagnosis.
